model_response: Will the US Bureau of Labor Statistics-reported Consumer Price Index (CPI) year-over-year inflation rate decrease below 2.0% for any month between November 21, 2026, and December 31, 2027?

forecast.classification_reasoning: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) year-over-year inflation rate is an aggregate macroeconomic indicator governed by monetary policy, labor markets, and commodity price trends. While subject to economic shocks, historical inflation rates cluster and evolve relatively continuously around central bank targets (typically 2%) rather than being driven by single, unpredictable black-swan outliers that dwarf all past history (unlike Extremistan / fat-tailed domains). It represents a repeatable, statistical time-series metric suitable for thin-tailed modeling techniques such as base rates, time-series analysis, and macroeconomic ensembling.
